Compare using a tolerance

Binary floating-point arithmetic can produce small rounding differences. isclose combines a relative tolerance based on the reference value and an absolute tolerance. Set the tolerances according to the scale and meaning of the numbers.

import numpy as np

print(np.isclose(0.1 + 0.2, 0.3, rtol=0, atol=1e-12))
print(np.isclose(0.02, 0.0, rtol=0, atol=0.01))
Example output
True
False

Distinguish NaN and infinity

isfinite excludes both NaN and positive or negative infinity. nanmean ignores NaN but can still include infinity. Choose a rule for invalid measurements and report how many observations each calculation actually used.

import numpy as np

a = np.array([2.0, np.nan, np.inf, 6.0])
valid = a[np.isfinite(a)]
print(valid.size, float(valid.mean()))
Example output
2 4.0
